core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hafa corresponds to the Arabic form حفا (Arabic root ح ف و (ḥ-f-w); حافي (ḥāfī) 'barefoot'). Its core sense is barefoot; the welcoming of a barefoot guest (arab custom). Hafa relates to the Arabic root ح ف و: حافي 'barefoot', and the classical Arab virtue of honouring 'the barefoot guest'. The source gloss 'gentle wind' is unsupported (that sense belongs to a different word) and its Arabic column gave هفى; the form is recorded at low confidence.
